source.title: Isekai Dark Fantasy Project.docx
source.access: approved local/private manuscript, NOT in GitHub
source.boundary: End precisely when Yuu realizes no blessing light is above him. Do not include Chapter 2.

format.style: 2D limited cutout/motion comic; narrative-driven, not static slideshow
format.targetSeconds: approximately 8–12 minutes, provisional and subordinate to faithful adaptation

planningRules.sourceOfTruth: Exact approved chapter must be consulted locally before writing spoken lines. This file includes original summaries, not canonical dialogue.
planningRules.uniforms: Keep Japanese school uniforms before AND immediately after summoning. Existing fantasy body art is not a canonical costume for Episode 001.
planningRules.elder: Avoid extreme mouth closeups; neutral speaking state, medium/wide reaction cuts and staff/other-character cutaways while facial source is limited.
planningRules.bracelet: Only one understated source-supported gesture on the bus; do not assign origin, powers or romantic meaning.
planningRules.speaker: ONE female Vietnamese narrator for narration and all dialogue; character speaker metadata only controls on-screen mouth reactions.
planningRules.timing: Use measured WAV durations; preserve silence and action-only holds; do not lock scene durations from provisional targets.
planningRules.resource: Limit Chromium render concurrency to 1 at preview; do not run local VieNeu-TTS at the same time as heavy rendering.
planningRules.media: Do not commit private manuscript or unapproved WAV/character concept images.

scenes.title: The empty seat

shots.description: Medium interior bus; a student asks about the vacant seat beside Yuu
The student changes direction to another available seat; Yuu remains alone
Wide bus interior; student groups talk while Yuu watches quietly
Close on Yuu placing his bag onto the empty seat, then looking away

deliberateSilentActions: the student's departure and reaction hold
requiredAssets: seated Yuu in modern Japanese uniform

scenes.title: Breakfast and Shiori

shots.description: Kairyū moves through the aisle and checks if Yuu has eaten
Kairyū puts a bread roll on the empty seat and pats Yuu's shoulder
Shiori approaches with class attendance paper and corrects the list with Kairyū
Yuu watches Shiori and Kairyū, then resumes looking at his phone

voiceTopics: Yuu's past friendship with Shiori and her present affection for Kairyū
deliberateSilentActions: the quiet glance toward the pair

scenes.title: Group assignment

shots.description: Yuu notices his name is missing from the six-person group list
Kairyū offers Yuu the last opening in his group; other classmates react awkwardly
Kairyū sits facing Yuu for a private conversation
Shiori waits near the aisle; she and Yuu exchange only a brief polite look

voiceTopics: Kairyū inviting Yuu and Yuu declining
requiredAssets: school bus seating pose for Kairyū

scenes.title: The frozen landscape

shots.description: Snacks are passed to other students but bypass Yuu
Yuu eats the bread alone; Kairyū and Shiori join a noisy guessing game at the front
Mountain road seen through the moving bus window; Yuu briefly handles his old silver bracelet and lowers his sleeve
A leaf hangs motionless outside; far clouds remain static despite the still-vibrating bus

voiceTopics: Yuu's restrained observations on exclusion and Kairyū
deliberateSilentActions: bread bite and moment of quiet
short bracelet interaction without emphasis or extra lore

scenes.title: Summoning on the bus

shots.description: Students and teacher shout as the bus seems stuck in a still world
Kairyū tells everyone to sit down; the first luminous runes appear beneath the seats
Large magic circle expands across the floor; passengers grab seats amid panic
Pure white light consumes the bus image; cut to darkness for the transition

voiceTopics: brief student panic and teacher's instruction

scenes.title: Waking in the stone hall

shots.description: Yuu wakes on the stone floor beneath unfamiliar vaulted architecture
Hall-wide shot: classmates scattered near a ritual circle; the bus has vanished
Yuu checks a phone with no signal and recovers his backpack
Kairyū organizes help for an injured student while Yuu offers a water bottle
Other classmates avoid conversation with Yuu; Shiori helps another injured classmate
Class counts reveal the school staff seem absent

voiceTopics: no service and search for the missing bus
checking for injuries and the water handoff
Yuu noticing absent teachers and social distance
deliberateSilentActions: brief reaction after someone avoids Yuu
requiredAssets: stone hall background with no windows
fallen and sitting uniform student poses

scenes.title: Yuu by the column

shots.description: Classmates gather around Kairyū while Yuu sits alone near a stone column
Kairyū speaks beside him; Yuu jokes about the hall having no windows
Kairyū returns to the larger group and Shiori hands him the list
The hall's massive stone door begins to open with a deep rumble

voiceTopics: Yuu's observation of the hall and isolation
Kairyū encouraging Yuu to remain with the group
Yuu's private comparison of Kairyū to a hero
requiredAssets: seated floor/stair pose for Yuu and Kairyū

scenes.title: The ritual delegation

shots.description: Silver-armored knights enter and form rows with white-robed clerics
Elder enters with a blue-gem staff and bows; avoid extreme facial closeups
Kairyū questions him; the class learns they have been summoned to another world
The elder explains the Demon King threat and asks for aid
The class becomes distressed when told there is currently no known return ritual
Kairyū requests safety and time to understand the situation

deliberateSilentActions: hall reaction without forced talking-mouth cycle
requiredAssets: elder fixed bust with neutral mouth

scenes.title: The blessings and the hero

shots.description: Elder invites the students to stand within the ritual circle
Kairyū makes room for Yuu; Shiori stands on Kairyū's other side
Glowing runes and multicolored lights gather overhead
A much stronger golden column surrounds Kairyū; a slender luminous sword appears
Knights kneel; the elder declares that a hero has appeared; classmates react

voiceTopics: class response to the golden light and sword
requiredAssets: kneeling knight pose or cropped shot

scenes.title: No light for Yuu

shots.description: Classmates receive more lights and celebrate; Kairyū remains in the golden pillar
Yuu waits expectantly and looks up
Slow, controlled camera framing shows empty darkness above Yuu, unlike everyone else
Hold for a quiet ending: the space above his head remains empty; stop at Chapter 1 boundary

voiceTopics: Yuu recognizing Kairyū as the hero
Yuu quietly hoping for a useful blessing
final internal realization that no light has come
